description: Election Commission - Revision of registers of electors for the yeas 2020
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the commencement of the revision of electoral registers for 2020, specifies where electoral registers will be displayed for public verification, and provides information about voter eligibility verification. The content specifically relates to electoral processes and voter registration matters under the Registration of Electors Act, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7). The notification is issued by the Election Commission, further confirming its electoral nature.
